references.text: The priest shall examine and isolate the sick person for seven days, following the same procedure as for other skin diseases.
A similar examination on the seventh day to see whether the rash has spread or not.
The context of this examination - the description of נֶתֶק (scab) and the yellow hairs as signs of impurity.
Continuation of the examination if the scab has not spread - the person shall be declared clean.
The principle that the wound must be examined to see whether it is deeper than the skin (עָמֹק מִן־הָעוֹר).
The priest's role in examining and declaring a person clean or unclean from a skin disease.
